fix: Take the dispatcher handle out of the borrow before dispatching: `let dispatcher = self.inner.borrow().root_back_dispatcher.dispatcher(); dispatcher.dispatch_back()`. Today the Ref is held while the always-registered back callback runs pop_inner, which calls inner.borrow_mut() on the same RefCell and panics.

Normalize once before the state borrow: `let path = route_path(information.location());` then use `.get(&path)` in the block and `if path == "/" && let Some(home) = home` below, so route_path (which allocates) runs once per lookup instead of twice (line 359 repeats it).

`normalized` is owned and unused after the lookup, so return it instead of cloning: `match normalized.char_indices().find(|(_, c)| matches!(c, '?' | '#')) { Some((index, _)) => normalized[..index].to_owned(), None => normalized }`.

Build from the route already read: add `fn build_route(&self, information: &RouteInformation) -> Widget` (the `widget_for(..).unwrap_or_else(..)` body of build_current_widget), then in the closure do `let child = retained.build_route(&information); Widget::environment_scope(WidgetsAppData { current_route: information, .. }, child)`. build_current_widget becomes ensure_initialized + current_route + build_route. This removes the second RouteInformation clone and lookup per rebuild (line 336 calls build_current_widget, which re-reads the route).

Return early when restoration is absent and serialize under the borrow: `let state = inner.borrow(); let Some(restoration) = state.restoration.clone() else { return }; let value = state.stack.iter().map(RouteInformation::to_json).collect::<Vec<_>>(); drop(state); restoration.scope.set_json(&restoration.key, value.into());`. The whole stack is currently cloned on every push, pop and replace even when restoration is not configured. Keep the drop before set_json, since it can re-enter the controller.

Existence checks should not run user builders: test `home` (for "/") and `routes.contains_key(&path)` directly, and call `generate_route` only when neither matches, since it is the only source that can report existence without building. Discarding a built Widget per navigation (push_inner, replace_inner, initial_stack loop) builds and drops a subtree and runs user code with side effects.

Build the prefixes incrementally into one buffer: `let mut prefix = String::new(); segments.iter().map(|segment| { prefix.push('/'); prefix.push_str(segment); prefix.clone() }).collect()`. This drops the per-prefix join and format! intermediates (two allocations per prefix) and keeps the same output.
`information` is not used after this report in replace_stack (the notify call reads the stack), so pass it by value: `information,` instead of `information.clone(),`.
`locale` is already an owned Locale from the `&& let Some(locale) = locale.clone()` binding, so move it: `Localizations::new(locale, SharedCatalog(catalog.clone()), child).into()`.
`environment` is a local whose last use is this line, so write `environment,` instead of cloning it (it is already normalized on line 951).

The revision bump `state.revision.set(state.revision.get().checked_add(1).expect("revision exhausted"))` is repeated at lines 401, 419, 480, 525, 560 and 593, plus invalidate(). Add a `bump_revision(&self)` method on WidgetsAppState and call it everywhere. The stack-restore branch in ensure_initialized (lines 393-410) also duplicates the default-initialization branch (lines 414-426), so merge them.
